name: review-chain
description: QC follow-up chain: one OC session takes the user's QC findings into a queue, spawns worker sessions (one per discussion-type feature, one bundled worker for small non-overlapping fixes) in their own git worktrees, checks file-scope conflicts before work starts, serializes merges, and owns shared files (version, release notes, progress ledger, external trackers). The user talks to workers directly in their tabs/panes; workers report to whichever OC is current via an indirection file, so the OC can be replaced when its context fills. Uses the tool-neutral agent-orchestrator in tools/.
